name: Naksan Fortress Wall & Cheonggyecheon Walk – Naksan Park → Dongdaemun → Cheonggye Plaza
desc: Naksan Park entrance up to the Seoul City Wall, along the Naksan Fortress Wall Trail (inner side, views over the city) down to Heunginjimun, then the Cheonggyecheon stream-level walkway west to Cheonggye Plaza. Street and path geometry from OpenStreetMap; the short Gwansugyo–Samilgyo stretch is laid along the stream bank because the walkway is not mapped there.

segments.label: Naksan Park entrance → park path via Central Plaza and First View Plaza → Seoul City Wall
Naksan Fortress Wall Trail (inner side) south past both secret gates to Heunginjimun Park
Heunginjimun Park → cross at Heunginjimun (Dongdaemun) → Cheonggyecheon Fashion Plaza
Cheonggyecheon stream-level walkway west: Ogansugyo → Beodeul-dari → Saebyeok-dari → Sewoon Bridge → Gwansugyo
Walkway Gwansugyo → Samilgyo (north bank; walkway not in OSM here, laid along the stream)
Walkway Samilgyo → Jangtonggyo → Gwangtonggyo → Mojeongyo → Cheonggye Plaza

waypoints.name: 1. Start – Naksan Park entrance (Naksan-gil, Dongsung-dong side)
waypoints.desc: Take the park path uphill. Naksan is only 125 m high but it is the best free viewpoint in central Seoul.
waypoints.label: Start

waypoints.name: 2. Naksan Park Central Plaza & Naksan Exhibition Hall
waypoints.desc: Small exhibition on the history of the wall and the hill. Toilets nearby.
waypoints.label: Central Plaza

waypoints.name: 3. Naksan Park First View Plaza
waypoints.desc: Panorama west over Jongno, Bukhansan and N Seoul Tower. Best at sunset; the wall is lit after dark.
waypoints.label: First View Plaza

waypoints.name: 4. Join the Seoul City Wall – Naksan section
waypoints.desc: Turn right (south) and keep the wall on your left all the way down to Dongdaemun. This is the Naksan Fortress Wall Trail.
waypoints.label: Wall trail start

waypoints.name: 5. First secret gate (Ammun A) – Ihwa Mural Village
waypoints.desc: Small gate through the wall. Step out for the Ihwa Mural Village lanes and come back the same way.
waypoints.label: Secret gate A

waypoints.name: 6. Ihwa Mural Village – angel wings mural (optional detour)
waypoints.desc: About 100 m down the lane from the gate. Residents live here: keep voices down.
waypoints.label: Ihwa murals

waypoints.name: 7. Second secret gate (Ammun B)
waypoints.desc: Stay inside the wall; the trail keeps descending.
waypoints.label: Secret gate B

waypoints.name: 8. Heunginjimun Park – view of Dongdaemun gate
waypoints.desc: The wall ends above the road with the gate below you. Lit wall photo spot at night.
waypoints.label: Heunginjimun Park

waypoints.name: 9. Heunginjimun (Dongdaemun Gate)
waypoints.desc: Boshin-era east gate, stands in the middle of the junction. Cross at the lights toward the stream.
waypoints.label: Dongdaemun gate

waypoints.name: 10. Cheonggyecheon Fashion Plaza (Cheonggye scene 4) – go down to the stream
waypoints.desc: Take the stairs to the stream-level walkway and walk west, upstream, all the way to Cheonggye Plaza (about 3.3 km).
waypoints.label: Fashion Plaza

waypoints.name: 11. Beodeul-dari (Jeon Tae-il Bridge)
waypoints.desc: Bronze statue of the labour activist Jeon Tae-il on the bridge; Pyeonghwa Market above.
waypoints.label: Jeon Tae-il Bridge

waypoints.name: 12. Saebyeok-dari – Gwangjang Market overhead
waypoints.desc: Gwangjang Market is directly above the north bank: stairs up if you want bindaetteok.
waypoints.label: Gwangjang Market

waypoints.name: 13. Sewoon Bridge & Sewoon Sangga sky deck
waypoints.desc: The rooftop walkway of the Sewoon electronics arcade crosses overhead.
waypoints.label: Sewoon Bridge

waypoints.name: 14. Jeongjo Banchado mural (Cheonggye scene 3)
waypoints.desc: 192 m ceramic-tile mural of King Jeongjo's royal procession along the south wall.
waypoints.label: Banchado mural

waypoints.name: 15. Gwangtonggyo (Cheonggye scene 2)
waypoints.desc: Restored Joseon-era stone bridge, the oldest on the stream.
waypoints.label: Gwangtonggyo

waypoints.name: 16. Candle Fountain & spring (Cheonggye scene 1)
waypoints.desc: The stream's source: two-tier waterfall and the 'Spring' sculpture. Lit up at night.
waypoints.label: Candle Fountain

waypoints.name: 17. End – Cheonggye Plaza
waypoints.desc: Gwanghwamun Station and City Hall are a few minutes away.
waypoints.label: End
